name: Kurumsal Çok Şubeli Ağ Mimarisi ve NGFW Tasarımı
summary: A global enterprise with Istanbul HQ (software, R&D, data center, public web and mobile app API gateway behind Cloudflare WAF), an Ankara R&D/DR and public-sector branch, a London Europe hub (UK-GDPR) and a 10,000-student academic campus (~20,900 endpoints). Palo Alto and FortiGate Active-Passive HA pairs enforce zero-trust VLAN segmentation, R&D proxy-only egress, role-based VPN with MFA (RADIUS/Azure AD), DDoS rate-limiting, nightly encrypted config-export backups, monthly firmware patching, 5651/KVKK/GDPR 2-year log retention, and a 24/7 NOC/SOC with SIEM, SOAR, NetFlow and NDR.

drivers: 5 Gbps primary symmetric Metro Ethernet + 2 Gbps redundant backup ISP fiber (SD-WAN failover)
R&D cloud sync via DLP proxy

chosen.reason: Preferred (2x Active-Passive HA). Delivers 22.5 Gbps Threat Prevention throughput for the 7 Gbps dual-ISP link with full TLS 1.3 decryption and App-ID micro-segmentation.

alternatives.reason: Strong NP7 ASIC throughput, but Layer-7 App-ID granularity for R&D/Software micro-segmentation is less flexible than PA-5410.
Higher latency under full TLS 1.3 inspection with heavy concurrent CI/CD and developer sessions.
FMC management console adds operational complexity for agile DevOps firewall rule provisioning.
Hardware acceleration and East-West data center routing scale are below headquarters SLA requirements.

rules.note: Rule 01: Drop RFC1918/bogon spoofed packets and threat-intel blocklist IPs arriving on WAN interfaces.
Rule 02 (Base DHCP): Allow all Istanbul HQ VLANs to obtain IP leases from internal DHCP server 10.10.100.5.
Rule 03 (Base DNS): Allow all Istanbul HQ VLANs to query internal DNS resolver 10.10.100.5 with DNS security filtering.
Rule 04 (Base NTP): Synchronize clocks across all HQ VLANs and firewalls with NTP server 10.10.100.5 for 5651/SIEM log integrity.
Rule 05 (DMZ Web & Mobile API + DDoS Rate-Limit): Allow HTTPS 443 through Cloudflare WAF to DMZ reverse proxy 10.10.90.10 with per-IP connection rate limiting.
Rule 06 (DMZ Isolation): Block any connection initiated from DMZ VLAN 90 toward internal headquarters LAN segments.
Rule 07 (VPN & Auth Rate-Limit): Rate-limit IKEv2 IPsec VPN and GlobalProtect MFA handshakes on WAN interface to prevent brute-force and DDoS floods.
Rule 08 (Bastion Management): Allow IT & SOC Management VLAN 99 (via MFA Bastion 10.10.99.20) to administer internal data center servers over SSH/HTTPS.
Rule 09 (Software to GitLab/CI): Allow Software Team VLAN 20 (180 devs) to access internal GitLab and CI/CD runners over SSH 22 and HTTPS 443.
Rule 10 (Software Egress): Allow Software Team VLAN 20 outbound HTTP/HTTPS access to GitHub, Docker Hub, npm and AWS with SSL inspection.
Rule 11 (R&D to GPU Cluster): Allow R&D VLAN 30 (90 researchers) to access isolated AI/ML compute cluster in VLAN 100.
Rule 12 (R&D Micro-Segmentation): Block lateral movement between R&D VLAN 30 and Staff, Software or Guest VLANs.
Rule 13 (R&D Proxy-Only Internet): Route R&D VLAN 30 outbound web requests exclusively through internal DLP forward proxy 10.10.100.10 (no direct internet).
Rule 14 (R&D Inter-Branch VPN): Allow encrypted dataset replication between Istanbul R&D VLAN 30 and Ankara R&D VLAN 30 over IPsec tunnel.
Rule 15 (Corporate Staff Web): Allow Administrative Staff VLAN 10 outbound HTTP/HTTPS access with web filtering and QoS.
Rule 16 (Guest & IoT Isolation): Block Guest/IoT VLAN 200 from reaching any internal HQ or remote branch private network.
Rule 17 (Guest Internet Egress): Allow Guest VLAN 200 outbound HTTP/HTTPS internet access capped at 10 Mbps per user.
Rule 18 (Central SIEM Syslog): Allow all branch firewalls and servers to forward TLS syslog (6514) telemetry to central SIEM collector 10.10.99.50.
Rule 99 (Default-Deny): Explicit catch-all default-deny rule; all unmatched traffic is dropped and logged to SIEM.

remoteAccess.note: No public SSH (port 22 closed on all WAN edges). Role-based VPN via GlobalProtect ZTNA and IPsec IKEv2 authenticated against Active Directory / RADIUS with mandatory MFA (2FA token) and HIP endpoint posture checks: IT/SOC admins reach only Management VLANs (VLAN 99/499) via Bastion jump host; software devs reach only GitLab/CI; staff reach only ERP. Nightly automated firewall config-export backups are stored in an encrypted Git/S3 vault with monthly restore drills and a monthly firmware patch window.

monitoring.siem: IBM QRadar / Splunk ES with Cortex XSOAR / FortiSOAR; firewall logs sent over TLS syslog (port 6514) to Istanbul HQ collectors and Ankara DR backup; hot log retention is 90 days in SIEM and 2 years time-stamped archive per Turkish Law 5651, KVKK, UK-GDPR and ISO 27001; NetFlow v9/IPFIX, SNMPv3 + Zabbix/Grafana for NOC; Darktrace/Vectra NDR on SPAN ports.
monitoring.owner: 24/7 SOC in Istanbul HQ with backup SOC in Ankara DR: 6 Tier-1 analysts (2 per 8h shift), 4 Tier-2 incident responders, 2 Tier-3 threat hunters, 4 NOC/network security engineers, and 1 SOC Manager / CISO.
monitoring.alertSink: SIEM correlation console, PagerDuty & encrypted Telegram/email channels for Tier-1/NOC on-call; SOAR automatically pushes quarantine/block commands to PA-5410 and FortiGate 3500F APIs.
monitoring.appVsSecurity: NOC engineers monitor availability, ISP link utilization, BGP/SD-WAN failover, HA state and hardware health in Zabbix/Grafana (SLA < 15 min), while SOC analysts monitor firewall blocks, WAF/IPS detections, MFA failures and NDR anomalies in SIEM/SOAR (Tier-1 triage < 15 min, Tier-2 IR < 30 min) so uptime noise never buries security alerts.

cveWatch.product: Palo Alto Networks PAN-OS (PA-5410 & PA-1410 GlobalProtect)
cveWatch.note: Temporary mitigation applied immediately via Threat Prevention signature 95187/95189 and disabling device telemetry; permanently patched to PAN-OS 11.1.2-h3 during emergency change window.
Temporary mitigation applied by disabling SSL-VPN web-mode and enforcing IPsec IKEv2 + MFA; permanently patched to FortiOS 7.4.3 across Ankara and Academic Campus HA clusters.
